camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList --region cn-hangzhou --FirewallConfigureStatus configured --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --FirewallId 'vfw-tr-5b202e7f0be646110000' --Lang zh
description_en: Queries information about all access control policy groups for VPC firewalls
description_zh: 获取VPC防火墙所有访问控制策略组信息
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-vpc-firewall-acl-group-list --lang zh --firewall-configure-status configured --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --firewall-id vfw-tr-5b202e7f0be646110000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpcFirewallAclGroupList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The configuration status of the VPC boundary firewall. Valid values:

configured: The VPC boundary firewall is configured.

If you omit this parameter, the operation queries the access control policies for all VPC boundary firewalls
parameters.help_zh:
VPC防火墙的配置状态。
configured：VPC边界防火墙已配置（即已创建了防火墙）。
不填：表示查询所有VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略
parameters.name: firewall_configure_status

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。
默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数。
可设置值最大为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC boundary firewall
parameters.name: firewall_id

AclGroupList.description_zh: VPC防火墙访问控制策略组的信息

items.description_en: The details of an access control policy group
items.description_zh: VPC防火墙访问控制策略组的详细信息

StrictMode.description_en:
Indicates whether strict mode is enabled. Valid values:

1: Strict mode is enabled.

0: Strict mode is disabled
StrictMode.description_zh:
是否启用严格模式

1：启用严格模式 
0：禁用严格模式

AclGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the access control policy group for the VPC boundary firewall.

Valid values:

If the VPC boundary firewall protects a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance, the policy group ID is the ID of the CEN instance.

  Example: cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

If the VPC boundary firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, the policy group ID is the ID of the VPC boundary firewall instance.

  Example: vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\
AclGroupId.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组ID。

取值：

VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。

  例如：cen-ervw0g12b5jbw\\

VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

  例如：vfw-a42bbb7b887148c9\\

AclGroupName.description_en:
The name of the access control policy group for the VPC boundary firewall.

If the VPC boundary firewall protects a Cloud Enterprise Network instance, the group name is the name of the CEN instance.

If the VPC boundary firewall protects an Express Connect circuit, the group name is the name of the VPC boundary firewall instance
AclGroupName.description_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略组名称。

VPC边界防火墙防护云企业网时，策略组名称使用云企业网名称。
VPC边界防火墙防护高速通道时，策略组名称使用VPC边界防火墙名称

AclRuleCount.description_en: The number of policies in the access control policy group
AclRuleCount.description_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略组的策略数量

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the policy group is a default group. Valid values:

true: The policy group is a default group.

false: The policy group is not a default group
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否是默认防火墙。取值：
true：是默认防火墙。
false：不是默认防火墙

MemberUid.description_en: The ID of the member account
MemberUid.description_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号ID

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of access control policy groups
TotalCount.description_zh: VPC防火墙访问控制策略组的总数量
